# 幻塔每周 UI 导航包

此包由当前 ADB 实机截图手动整理。图片资源已以内嵌 Base64 保存；运行时直接加载本文件，不再依赖旧的 `flows/tower-of-fantasy/` 目录。

```navigation-json
{
  "metadata": {
    "id": "tower-of-fantasy-weekly-ui",
    "name": "幻塔每周 UI 导航",
    "version": "2026.09"
  },
  "scenarios": [
    {
      "id": "weekly-ui",
      "title": "云幻塔每周必做（非战斗优先）",
      "priority": 80,
      "navigators": [
        "ui"
      ]
    }
  ],
  "states": [
    {
      "id": "world",
      "scenarioId": "weekly-ui",
      "uis": [
        "game-world"
      ],
      "topmost": "game-world",
      "markers": [
        {
          "assetId": "world-hud",
          "threshold": 0.72
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "weekly",
      "scenarioId": "weekly-ui",
      "uis": [
        "must-do",
        "weekly-tab"
      ],
      "topmost": "weekly-tab",
      "markers": [
        {
          "assetId": "must-do-title",
          "threshold": 0.82
        },
        {
          "assetId": "weekly-tab",
          "threshold": 0.80
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "mia",
      "scenarioId": "weekly-ui",
      "uis": [
        "must-do",
        "mia"
      ],
      "topmost": "mia",
      "markers": [
        {
          "assetId": "mia-title",
          "threshold": 0.82
        }
      ]
    }
  ],
  "flows": [
    {
      "id": "open-weekly",
      "scenarioId": "weekly-ui",
      "navigator": "ui",
      "start": "tap-must-do",
      "steps": [
        {
          "id": "tap-must-do",
          "kind": "action",
          "assetId": "must-do-tight",
          "threshold": 0.50,
          "clickPoint": {
            "x": 0.5,
            "y": 0.5
          },
          "goto": "weekly-ready"
        },
        {
          "id": "weekly-ready",
          "kind": "terminal",
          "terminal": true
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "open-mia",
      "scenarioId": "weekly-ui",
      "navigator": "ui",
      "start": "tap-mia-forward",
      "steps": [
        {
          "id": "tap-mia-forward",
          "kind": "action",
          "assetId": "mia-forward",
          "threshold": 0.55,
          "clickPoint": {
            "x": 0.82,
            "y": 0.62
          },
          "goto": "mia-ready"
        },
        {
          "id": "mia-ready",
          "kind": "terminal",
          "terminal": true
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "taste-mia",
      "scenarioId": "weekly-ui",
      "navigator": "ui",
      "start": "taste",
      "steps": [
        {
          "id": "taste",
          "kind": "action",
          "assetId": "mia-taste",
          "threshold": 0.72,
          "clickPoint": {
            "x": 0.63,
            "y": 0.80
          },
          "goto": "weekly-ready"
        },
        {
          "id": "weekly-ready",
          "kind": "terminal",
          "terminal": true
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "claim-noncombat-rewards",
      "scenarioId": "weekly-ui",
      "navigator": "ui",
      "start": "claim-online",
      "steps": [
        {
          "id": "claim-online",
          "kind": "action",
          "assetId": "claim-online",
          "threshold": 0.72,
          "clickPoint": {
            "x": 0.82,
            "y": 0.64
          },
          "goto": "claim-shop"
        },
        {
          "id": "claim-shop",
          "kind": "action",
          "assetId": "shop-reward",
          "threshold": 0.72,
          "clickPoint": {
            "x": 0.82,
            "y": 0.64
          },
          "goto": "done"
        },
        {
          "id": "done",
          "kind": "terminal",
          "terminal": true
        }
      ]
    }
  ],
  "goals": [
    {
      "id": "tower-of-fantasy-weekly-panel",
      "kind": "ui",
      "delegate": "ui",
      "flowId": "open-weekly",
      "period": "weekly",
      "success": "state.topmost == \"weekly-tab\""
    },
    {
      "id": "tower-of-fantasy-open-mia",
      "kind": "ui",
      "delegate": "ui",
      "flowId": "open-mia",
      "period": "weekly"
    },
    {
      "id": "tower-of-fantasy-taste-mia",
      "kind": "ui",
      "delegate": "ui",
      "flowId": "taste-mia",
      "period": "weekly"
    },
    {
      "id": "tower-of-fantasy-claim-noncombat-rewards",
      "kind": "ui",
      "delegate": "ui",
      "flowId": "claim-noncombat-rewards",
      "period": "weekly"
    }
  ]
}
```
